name: bombcat
description: 炸弹猫网页版：联机对战 + 深度定制（自定义卡面/角色技能/特殊卡牌）+ 用户系统

scripts.build: npm run build -w @bombcat/server && npm run build -w @bombcat/client
scripts.test: npm run test -w @bombcat/shared && npm run test -w @bombcat/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @bombcat/shared && npm run typecheck -w @bombcat/server && npm run typecheck -w @bombcat/client
